description:
Hwan Woon-Ryong and Beom Pung-Ho have spent their entire lives locked in a fierce rivalry. As the heirs to the world’s two most powerful crime syndicates, their hatred runs deep—and so does their competition. But just as they’re poised to seize the biggest opportunity of their careers, fate throws them a curveball: a toddler named Hwan Beom-Hae, who, according to advanced DNA testing, is the biological child of both of them. Caught between disbelief and chaos, the two enemies are presented with an absurd yet high-stakes mission: raise Beom-Hae together, lovingly and responsibly. The reward? Exclusive construction rights to the largest global development project in history, sanctioned by the United Nations itself. But co-parenting isn’t exactly easy when you’d rather strangle your partner than share snack time and diaper duty. As Beom-Hae’s giggles and tantrums slowly chip away at their walls, Woon-Ryong and Pung-Ho must navigate tantrums, toys, and a growing sense of responsibility—not to mention some unexpected feelings. Can two lifelong enemies become the world’s most unlikely dream team dads? Or will their stubborn pride and unresolved tension bring everything crashing down? 

Enemies-to-daddies has never looked this chaotic—or this heartwarming. 

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)
